failure_type: late detection (short sensing range) + UAV too fast to react
explanation: The UAV collided with a static obstacle at 4.0 seconds because it only detected the object 1.2 seconds before the closest approach. Given the UAV's cruise speed of 8.9 m/s and the limited sensing range of 10.3 m, the planner had insufficient time to calculate a safe trajectory to avoid the collision.
